game_title: Code Reading Relay – Dry Well Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Dry Well, a nearly dry well: the sand ranger must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dry Well: a nearly dry well
core_gameplay_loop: In Dry Well, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the predicted value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about predicted to power up the sand ranger and open the supply tent.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 4 (applied tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Code Reading Relay' (Week 9 slot 10), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Dry Well'. region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predicted changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dry Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
